title: Watch: Iran's Araghchi says US the ‘main cause of insecurity’ in region
summary:
Watch: Iran's Araghchi says US the ‘main cause of insecurity’ in region

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told reporters on Monday that regional issues should be resolved through diplomacy, blaming the US for insecurity and tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
